presentation.label: SMART RELOAD
presentation.summary: In arranger mode, RELOAD PART brings back the scenes of the arrangement row you are on instead of the Part's saved ones.
presentation.overview: An arrangement row can choose scenes A and B. Stock's RELOAD PART (FUNC + CUE) puts the Part's saved scenes back, so after a reload during a song the crossfader no longer morphs between the row's scenes. With Smart Reload, the reload goes as usual and the current row's scenes A and B come straight back. A side set to -- gets the scene the rows above left, as the row plays without a reload, and in pattern mode nothing changes.
highlights: RELOAD PART in arranger mode keeps the current row's scenes A and B, heard at once
A side set to -- gets what the rows above left, as the row plays without a reload
Pattern mode and every other reload stay exactly stock's
usage: In arranger mode, set scenes A and B in an arrangement row (the SCENE column).
Play the arrangement, tweak the Part, then press FUNC + CUE: the Part reloads and the row's scenes stay selected.

limitations: Only the Part in use is given the row's scenes: RELOAD from the Part menu for another Part is stock's.
Stopped, the row is the one PLAY continues from; nothing changes when there is none.
Tested on one MKI only; not with other modules installed.

access.location: Main screen, arranger mode: FUNC + CUE (RELOAD PART)
steps: Switch arranger mode on (FUNC + PATTERN on the MKI) and set scenes A and B in an arrangement row.
Save the Part (Part menu, SAVE), then play the arrangement.
Press FUNC + CUE: the Part reloads and the row's scenes A and B stay selected.
